text:
This weekend, the arrivals team read your thoughts with care and I am writing on behalf of Aurelia Skyways to acknowledge your concern about the handling of your companion animal during your recent journey.

We understand that this experience left you disappointed, and we regret that the service you received did not meet the standards expected from the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Every traveling pet is intended to be handled with steady attention, calm procedures, and close coordination between ground staff and the safety coordinator. When a journey feels uncertain to a traveler, it is important to us that the reason is explained clearly and that any failure is addressed without delay.

Your complaint has been reviewed as part of our routine desk work, and the details have been shared with the teams responsible for pet acceptance, transfer oversight, and arrival support. The safety coordinator has also examined the reported concerns for any hazard that may have affected the comfort or welfare of the animal. Where a process has not been followed properly, we treat that as a matter for correction, retraining, and closer supervision. We do not take lightly any report that suggests a pet or traveler was left uneasy.

Please be assured that our staff are reminded to check carrier condition, loading coordination, and arrival handling with particular care whenever a pet is in our custody. We also review communication between the desk and the ramp team so that instructions are clear and support is timely. If you have additional observations that may help us understand the event more fully, they will be welcomed and added to the case record for further review. Our aim is to reduce avoidable stress for both travelers and animals, and to restore confidence in the service we provide.

We regret the frustration this has caused and appreciate that you brought the matter to our attention. Aurelia Skyways remains committed to respectful, careful treatment of all companion animals and to improving the consistency of our service.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
